title: He Has Arrived!! The Boy Who Possesses Solar Hands!
overview: Ten years after discovering his passion for bread, Kazuma Azuma heads to Tokyo with a dream of creating "Ja-pan," a bread that Japan can proudly call its own. Flashbacks reveal how a chance meeting with a traveling baker awakened his talent and inspired his goal, while his first day at Pantasia's recruitment exam gets off to a rocky start after he arrives late to the competition.

title: Maharajah!! The Day Mount Fuji Fell!
overview: Kazuma Azuma's dream debut at Pantasia begins with a string of costly mistakes, leaving him at a severe disadvantage in the recruitment exam. As he befriends fellow applicants and faces sabotage from a determined rival, Azuma relies on his natural talent and creativity to impress the judges with an unconventional bread that proves he belongs among Japan's finest young bakers.

title: Burnt Black!! Is This the Final Kurowa-san?!
overview: The Pantasia recruitment exam reaches its final round with a croissant challenge, but an unexpected misunderstanding leads Kazuma Azuma to make a difficult decision. Choosing to help Kawachi instead of competing for himself, Azuma puts friendship before victory, and their bold collaboration changes the outcome of the competition in ways no one anticipated.

title: Hihiin!! Make a Delicious Bread!
overview: Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi begin their first day at Pantasia's Southern Tokyo Branch and are introduced to the bakery's unconventional manager, Ken Matsushiro. Tasked with creating a loaf that even a horse will willingly eat, the pair uncover the heartfelt reason behind Matsushiro's unusual standards and set out to bake bread that everyone can enjoy.

title: De-licious!! A Decisively Ultimate Butter!
overview: With their positions at Pantasia on the line, Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi race to create a delicious bread free of common dairy allergens. Inspired by a timely suggestion from his sister, Azuma develops an unconventional recipe that fulfills the manager's true goal, proving that great bread can be both flavorful and accessible.

title: It's the Main Store!! Dancing Meister!
overview: Business is slow at Pantasia's Southern Tokyo Branch, where Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi soon discover they are competing with a popular rival bakery across the street. After Ken Matsushiro boldly challenges St. Pierre to a televised bread showdown, the fate of the branch—and Pantasia's reputation—rests on Azuma's ability to create a winning new Ja-pan.

title: Hattori Surprise!! Transformation With the Secret Sauce!
overview: Pantasia and St. Pierre face off in a televised bread duel, with both bakeries unveiling innovative creations to impress the judges. As St. Pierre's luxurious new pastry earns top marks, Kazuma Azuma counters with an inventive recipe that transforms leftover bread into a delicious snack, turning the contest into an unexpected deadlock.

title: Kawachi Kai!! The Solar Gauntlet!
overview: Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi are invited to Pantasia's annual Newcomers Competition, where the first challenge is to create bread that can stay fresh for weeks without molding. While Kawachi undergoes unusual training in hopes of developing abilities like Azuma's legendary Solar Hands, Azuma sets off on a determined journey to gather a key ingredient for his next Ja-pan.

title: I Won't Lose!! I Challenge You With my Osaka Bread!
overview: As the Newcomers Competition approaches, Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi pursue separate paths to perfect their entries. While Azuma's search for a special ingredient leads to an unexpected burst of inspiration, Kawachi overcomes his self-doubt and discovers a recipe that honors his late father's dream of becoming a Pantasia baker.

title: Each One's Opening Curtain!! The Pantasia Newcomers' Battle Begins!
overview: The Pantasia Newcomers Competition begins with Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi ready to prove themselves after surviving the preliminary round. When a dispute erupts over the elimination of several contestants, Kazuma stands up for his fellow bakers, leading to an unexpected decision that gives one determined competitor a second chance.

title: Garbage and Trash!! Kazuma Selected the Worst Possible Butter!
overview: The first round of the Pantasia Newcomers Competition challenges the contestants to bake a simple butter roll, testing their skill and judgment as much as their baking ability. While Katsuo Umino and Kyosuke Kawachi impress with their careful selection of ingredients, Kazuma Azuma's overconfidence leads to a costly mistake that puts his tournament hopes in jeopardy.

title: Kazuma Disqualified!? Resurrection from the Brink of Death by Ultra C!
overview: Although Kazuma Azuma is disqualified for choosing the wrong ingredient, his innovative baking technique earns unexpected praise and keeps his reputation intact. After the round, a family dispute within Pantasia draws Kazuma and Kyosuke Kawachi into a high-stakes rivalry, as a challenge from Tsukino's ambitious younger half-sister raises the stakes far beyond the competition itself.

title: Sorry for the Wait!! Meron Meron with Melon Bread!
overview: Facing a wager against Mizuno, Kazuma Azuma must master a bread he has never made before: melon bread. An unexpected source of inspiration leads him to create a unique new Ja-pan, earning him victory through ingenuity, but Mizuno refuses to concede and reveals a mysterious new challenger to continue their rivalry.

title: Delii-cious!! The Trap of the Yakisoba Bread!
overview: After advancing through the melon bread challenge, Kazuma Azuma and Kyosuke Kawachi prepare for the next round, where the focus shifts to creating the ultimate yakisoba bread. As Kawachi adapts quickly to intensive wok training, Kazuma struggles to keep up while learning that his next opponent possesses exceptional stir-frying skills.

title: The Best Possible Team!! We're Going to Win with Onono Komachi-san!
overview: The yakisoba bread challenge continues as Kyosuke Kawachi secures a convincing victory with an inventive twist on the classic filling. Inspired by his partner's encouragement, Kazuma Azuma overcomes a formidable opponent by reimagining the bread itself, proving that creativity can triumph even when the filling falls short.

title: The Green Marvel!! It's the Magician Kazuma!
overview: As the competition moves into its next round, a mysterious contestant's true identity begins to emerge after an unexpected confrontation. The remaining bakers are challenged to create an animal-themed bread that appeals to children and families, leading Kazuma Azuma to face a crafty rival with a dazzling braided creation of his own.

title: The Great Decisive Battle!! Koala's Dragon vs. Kazuma's Turtle!
overview: Kazuma Azuma and his masked opponent deliver equally impressive animal-themed breads, leaving the judges unable to choose a clear winner. However, the match takes an unexpected turn when the truth behind Mr. Koala's motives comes to light, bringing an end to Mizuno's wager and revealing a far greater threat facing Pantasia.

title: With a Little Prayer!! An Oath on the Grave!
overview: Kyosuke Kawachi advances through the animal bread round under unusual circumstances, while Kazuma Azuma and his friends uncover the painful history behind Tsukino's family. After learning of the hardships she has endured and the influence of her ruthless older sister, the pair renew their resolve to win the Newcomers Competition for Tsukino's sake.

title: The Nightmarish Semi-Finals!! Yukino's Despicable Trap!
overview: The Newcomers Competition reaches the semifinals as Kyosuke Kawachi faces the brilliant Shigeru Kanmuri in a high-stakes baking duel. While Kanmuri reveals the depth of his scientific expertise, Kawachi's chances are threatened by a hidden act of sabotage, raising the stakes before the judges and Pantasia's top executives.

title: The Indomitable Fighting Spirit!! Use Adversity as a Springboard to Success!
overview: Kawachi's semifinal match takes a disastrous turn when his dough refuses to rise despite every effort to save it. As his opponent delivers a flawless performance, Kawachi is forced to confront both the effects of unseen sabotage and the gap in skill separating him from the tournament's strongest competitor.

title: The Experimental, Historical, Supreme Bread!! It`s Japan #44!
overview: Kazuma Azuma faces Kai Suwabara in a spectacular semifinal showdown, with both bakers unveiling the finest techniques they have to offer. As Suwabara pushes his skills to the limit, Kazuma counters with his perfected Ja-pan, delivering a loaf so extraordinary that its unforgettable taste leaves the judges with an experience unlike anything they have ever encountered.

title: Before the Finals!! A Dark Shadow Approaches Kazuma
overview: As the stage is set for the Newcomers Competition final, evidence emerges that Kyosuke Kawachi was sabotaged, though the culprit remains beyond reach. While Kawachi prepares for a third-place match and Kazuma Azuma readies himself for the championship, a final act of sabotage threatens to undermine Kazuma's greatest advantage before the decisive battle begins.

title: The Sticky Showdown!! Azuma Kazuma VS Kanmuri Shigeru!
overview: As Kazuma Azuma and Shigeru Kanmuri prepare for the championship match, both bakers are forced to adapt under mounting pressure. With his trusted baking stone gone and the crowd expecting his signature Ja-pan, Kazuma unveils an entirely new approach, while Kanmuri faces growing pressure from Yukino to secure victory at any cost.

title: The Meister, Taking Wing!! Who is to Win!?
overview: The Newcomers Competition reaches its climax as Kazuma Azuma and Shigeru Kanmuri present their final creations before Pantasia's top judges. Despite Kanmuri's flawless technique and premium ingredients, Kazuma's unconventional approach produces a remarkable bread that secures a dramatic victory and crowns him the tournament champion.

title: What Was That?! Kawachi, a Man's Hard Training!
overview: Following the championship match, the competition concludes with a battle for third place between Kyosuke Kawachi and Kai Suwabara. Inspired by an unusual lesson about breaking free from conventional thinking, Kawachi unveils an unconventional baguette as both bakers strive to end the tournament on a high note.

title: The Last Match of the Newcomers' Battle!! The Singing and Dancing French Breads!
overview: The battle for third place concludes as Kyosuke Kawachi and Kai Suwabara showcase two highly original takes on the classic French baguette. With both bakers demonstrating exceptional creativity and technique, the judges are unable to separate them, bringing the Newcomers Competition to a fittingly hard-fought conclusion.

title: Let's All Make Bread Together!! It's Japan #2!
overview: With the Newcomers Competition over, the winners receive their rewards and Pantasia undergoes several unexpected personnel changes. As Kazuma Azuma continues experimenting with new baking techniques to satisfy customers, a new alliance forms behind the scenes, setting the stage for Pantasia's next challenge.

title: The Ten Billion Yen Man?! Pantasia's Life or Death Crisis!
overview: As Kyosuke Kawachi settles into Pantasia's main branch, Shigeru Kanmuri joins the Southern Tokyo team and uncovers a plot that could put the entire company at risk. While the bakers develop an innovative new bread to boost business, Kanmuri proposes an ambitious plan to save Pantasia by competing on the international stage at the prestigious Monaco Cup.

title: Close Attack!! The Birth of the Black Japan!
overview: St. Pierre attempts to undermine Pantasia by copying the Southern Tokyo Branch's newest bread and falsely claiming it as its own. In response, Kazuma Azuma creates an innovative new croissant whose unforgettable flavor exposes the deception, turning the rival bakery's scheme against itself.

title: And Now, It's France! Aim for the Monaco Cup!
overview: Kazuma Azuma, Kyosuke Kawachi, and Kai Suwabara arrive in France to begin their preparations for the Monaco Cup under the guidance of Sophie Balzac Kirisaki. As they settle into their training, they meet France's formidable representatives, whose remarkable baking skills offer a glimpse of the fierce international competition that lies ahead.

title: The Critical Touch and Go Situation!! The Prohibited Rodin Strategy!
overview: Training in France takes an unexpected turn as Team Japan prepares a decorative bread for the Monaco Cup's opening exhibition. Following a secret plan orchestrated by Shigeru Kanmuri, the team deliberately courts disaster to lower expectations, entering the tournament as underestimated underdogs despite a rocky start.

title: World-class Level!! The Roulette that Calls a Storm
overview: The Monaco Cup begins with a challenging preliminary round that forces each team to bake using only randomly assigned ingredients. After Team Japan receives an especially unfavorable draw, Kazuma Azuma must rely on one of his earlier Ja-pan creations to overcome the odds and keep Japan's hopes alive.

title: Snacks at 3 p.m.!! It's Japan #21!
overview: Against all expectations, Team Japan turns a seemingly impossible first-round draw into a surprise success, earning the judges' respect through Kazuma Azuma's ingenuity. Their performance attracts the attention of France's youngest representative, Edward Kayser, setting up a new challenge in which Kai Suwabara must overcome a complicated test of both skill and strategy.

title: Lupin #3!! Kai`s Pan.De.Ebisu
overview: Team Japan's second preliminary challenge falls to Kai Suwabara, who must transform an overwhelming assortment of required ingredients into a cohesive loaf. Drawing on his unique baking philosophy and exceptional technique, Kai delivers a creative bread that earns high praise and keeps Team Japan firmly in contention.

title: The World is Watching!! Monaco Cup Main Lane Start!
overview: With the preliminary rounds complete, Team Japan advances to the next stage of the Monaco Cup as the competition intensifies. While St. Pierre launches a new offensive against Pantasia back in Japan, the remaining teams face a demanding speed challenge that tests both their efficiency and baking precision under strict time limits.

title: A Speed Contest!! Ping It with That!
overview: Facing elimination in a high-pressure speed challenge, Team Japan turns to an unconventional baking method in a last-ditch effort to finish on time. Despite the judge's strong prejudice against their approach, Kazuma Azuma's ingenuity once again proves decisive, securing the final spot in the Monaco Cup's next round as new developments unfold back at Pantasia and St. Pierre.

title: Survival! Bakers on an Uninhabited Island
overview: The Monaco Cup quarterfinals take the competitors to a deserted island, where each team must create a sweet bread using only the natural resources around them. Team Japan's challenge becomes even more difficult when outside interference leaves the members separated and stranded in an especially unforgiving location, forcing them to survive as much as they must compete.

title: Now Then, Swim!! The 'Fried Fish' of the South Island!
overview: After a devastating fire leaves their island stripped of its resources, Team Japan must rely on creativity and teamwork to complete the quarterfinal challenge. Turning unexpected ingredients into a distinctive new Ja-pan, the trio battles exhaustion to present their bread and keep their Monaco Cup campaign alive.

title: A Dive into Hell!! A New Scheme!
overview: A rematch sends the Monaco Cup competitors to Mexico for a fish-themed baking challenge, but Team Japan's journey is sabotaged before it even begins. Stranded deep within a massive cave alongside the event's chief judge, Kazuma Azuma and his teammates must find a way to escape if they hope to remain in the tournament.

title: Pierrot's Miscalculation!! How the Last Dinner Tastes
overview: Still trapped beneath the earth, Team Japan searches for a way out while Pierrot's bizarre reaction to Kazuma Azuma's bread takes an unexpected turn. As time runs short, an unlikely discovery offers the group's best chance of escaping the cave and returning to the Monaco Cup.

title: The King's Question!! Who is the First Person to Whom You Feed Your Bread?
overview: With the sabotage exposed, the Monaco Cup comes under new leadership as Team Japan advances to a semifinal showdown against France. While preparing for a sports-themed challenge, Kazuma Azuma learns more about the Kirisaki family's troubled past, uncovering connections that hint at the deeper motives driving the fierce rivalry between Pantasia and St. Pierre.

title: Mysterious Brothers!! Kaizer's Natural Shape!
overview: Team Japan's semifinal against the formidable Kayser brothers begins under intense pressure as Kazuma Azuma is nowhere to be found. Forced to face France's strongest bakers before a hostile home crowd, Kyosuke Kawachi and Kai Suwabara must rely on their own skills against opponents who finally reveal the full extent of their extraordinary abilities.

title: Lots of Nutrients!! The Sports Bread Showdown!
overview: Kazuma Azuma arrives just in time to join Team Japan's semifinal against the Kayser brothers, transforming what seemed like a hopeless match into a dramatic showdown. By combining nutritional insight with inventive baking, Team Japan overcomes France's finest and earns a hard-fought place in the Monaco Cup final.

title: The Sound Speed Threat!! Gopan #97
overview: With Team Japan through to the Monaco Cup final, the bakers celebrate before learning that their last obstacle is the powerful American team led by the enigmatic Shadow. As the championship's three-part format is revealed, each member of Team Japan prepares for a decisive one-on-one match while Kazuma Azuma finds renewed determination after meeting his formidable rival.

title: Nude Nude Nude!! Magnificent Bread Battle!
overview: The Monaco Cup final begins with Kai Suwabara representing Team Japan in the opening match against Monica Adenauer, America's gifted pastry specialist. As the two bakers showcase their creativity through breads inspired by clothing and personal style, Kai unveils a carefully prepared Lupan creation in a battle that is only just beginning.

title: Pierrot Arrested! Bows Between Love and Bread!
overview: The Monaco Cup final opens with an intense showdown between Kai Suwabara and Monica Adenauer, as both bakers present imaginative creations inspired by clothing. Although Monica claims the first victory with her masterful craftsmanship, Kai's gracious response earns the respect of his opponent and reveals the dedication hidden behind her remarkable talent.

title: Victory! Bring a Revolution to the Bread Industry!
overview: After Team Japan falls behind in the Monaco Cup final, Kyosuke Kawachi must carry the pressure of the second match against his former rival, Shachihoko. Inspired by his late father's unwavering determination, Kawachi sets out to create a bold new bread that reflects both his family's legacy and his own growth as a baker.

title: Great Dectective Piero!! Reaction that Gave Life!
overview: Kyosuke Kawachi's championship match against Shachihoko reaches its climax as both bakers present inventive breads designed to complement any meal. Amid another of Judge Pierrot's bizarre tasting reactions, Kawachi's persistence and inspired craftsmanship earn Team Japan a crucial victory, sending the Monaco Cup final to a winner-take-all showdown between Kazuma Azuma and Shadow.

title: Reunion at the VIP seat!! Heaven Again
overview: As the Monaco Cup final is interrupted by Judge Pierrot's sudden collapse, a shocking revelation about his past changes the course of the competition. Moved by the tragedy, Kazuma Azuma vows to create a new Ja-pan capable of delivering one final miracle as the decisive championship match approaches.

title: Confuse the Universe!! Man who Succeeded Gopan
overview: The Monaco Cup reaches its final match as Kazuma Azuma prepares to face the mysterious Shadow White in a battle to create a bread that embodies the taste of one's homeland. As Shadow's tragic past and extraordinary talent come to light, Team Japan steels itself for a showdown against the tournament's most formidable baker.

title: Final Ingredients Assembled!! Greatest Tournament in History
overview: The decisive Monaco Cup final begins as Kazuma Azuma and Shadow White unveil their ultimate creations in a battle to represent the flavors of their homelands. Shadow's remarkable Gopan delivers an emotional tasting experience that leaves the audience convinced of his victory, but Team Japan remains confident that Kazuma's newest Ja-pan has yet to make its impact.

title: Pierrot Transcends Time!! Japan to the Top of the World!?
overview: The Monaco Cup reaches its unforgettable conclusion as Kazuma Azuma presents his final Ja-pan against Shadow White's masterpiece. With a bread crafted entirely by hand, Kazuma delivers an extraordinary tasting experience that secures victory for Team Japan, bringing the international tournament to a triumphant close and leaving a lasting impression on everyone involved.

title: Challenge From Kirisaki! New Program Yakitate!! 9 Starts
overview: Fresh off their Monaco Cup victory, Kazuma Azuma and the Pantasia team return to Japan only to find themselves drawn into a new nationwide baking competition orchestrated by Mr. Kirisaki. As preparations for the Yakitate! 9 tournament begin, Ken Matsushiro reveals the history behind Ryou Kuroyanagi's career, leading the celebrated food critic to make a pivotal decision about his future.

title: The Great Battles in Special Localities!! In the End, He's a Pop Idol!
overview: The nationwide Yakitate! 9 tournament begins with Kazuma Azuma representing Pantasia against celebrity chef Takumi Tsubozuka of St. Pierre. Faced with a shortage of the region's signature ingredient after a calculated act of sabotage, Azuma turns to an unconventional strategy that leaves even his teammates wondering what he has planned.

title: Awaken!! Super Kuroyanagi!
overview: Kazuma Azuma and Takumi Tsubozuka's opening Yakitate! 9 match reaches its conclusion as both bakers unveil breads inspired by Ōma's local seafood. By making full use of regional ingredients and an ingenious preparation method, Azuma overcomes his celebrity opponent and gives Pantasia an early lead in the nationwide tournament.

title: Kuroyanagi in Danger!! The Lost Reactions!
overview: Pantasia's next Yakitate! 9 match pits Kazuma Azuma against master chef Ryuu Roumen in a challenge to reinvent steamed pork dumplings using local specialties. As Judge Ryou Kuroyanagi struggles with a sudden loss of taste that threatens the competition itself, Azuma's inventive recipe is put to the test in more ways than one.

title: Oo, Mango!! CMAP's Big Counterattack!
overview: Pantasia's next Yakitate! 9 challenge sends Kazuma Azuma against the remaining members of CMAP in a battle centered on Saito's famous mangoes. As the celebrity chefs combine their talents into a formidable team effort, Azuma experiments with an unconventional idea that leaves even his allies questioning whether his risky approach can succeed.

title: Love also Rescues Saito!! Solar Hands vs the Flame Arm!
overview: The Saito mango challenge reaches its conclusion as Kazuma Azuma and the CMAP team present their creations to the judges. While the celebrity chefs impress with technical skill, Azuma's handcrafted approach and heartfelt use of local ingredients prove decisive, earning Pantasia another victory in the Yakitate! 9 tournament.

title: Nin Nin Nin!! My Way of Ninja!
overview: The Yakitate! 9 tournament moves to Ōmagari, where Kazuma Azuma faces a pair of mysterious ninja bakers in a challenge featuring the region's distinctive curved scallions. As both sides arrive at remarkably similar ideas, the outcome hinges on which team can elevate its creation with the more ingenious technique.

title: I Hate Things that Turn!! Kai and Monica's Three-Legged Race!
overview: Kazuma Azuma's ninja-themed match takes an unexpected turn when the masked St. Pierre bakers are revealed to be Kai Suwabara and Monica Adenauer. As the bread battle gives way to an emotional confrontation, long-buried feelings and a startling revelation reshape the futures of both rivals, leaving the competition momentarily forgotten.

title: Kanmuri's Secret!! A Jam Showdown Without Moral Codes
overview: As Yakitate! 9 continues, Shigeru Kanmuri is forced to confront his family's criminal legacy when his estranged half-brother challenges him to a match that will decide both their futures. With Kazuma Azuma sidelined by illness, Kanmuri must overcome the pressure of the high-stakes duel while fighting to preserve his dream of baking.

title: The Sibling Showdown!! The First Class Man Chosen by Dad!
overview: Shigeru Kanmuri and his half-brother face off in a decisive jam-making contest that will determine the future of their family. Inspired by an unexpected idea and supported by his friends, Kanmuri delivers a unique creation that changes more than just the outcome of the competition.

title: Seaweed Bread Showdown!! A Really Famous Person is Gonna Appear, You Know!
overview: Pantasia enters a critical round of the Yakitate! 9 tournament, where a single loss could erase its commanding lead. Facing renowned nori expert Miki Norihei, Kazuma Azuma experiments with an unconventional approach to the region's signature ingredient as the crowd quickly falls under his opponent's spell.

title: A Traditional Taste! The Heart That Thinks of Japan is Just One!
overview: The nori-themed showdown reaches its conclusion as Kazuma Azuma and celebrated chef Miki Norihei present two remarkably different interpretations of the same ingredient. Although Pantasia suffers its first defeat in the Yakitate! 9 tournament, Azuma earns the admiration of his opponent, who recognizes a shared passion for blending Japanese and Western culinary traditions.

title: The Fearful Revenge!! The Panda Man Appears!
overview: With Pantasia trailing in the Yakitate! 9 tournament, Kazuma Azuma faces the return of the mysterious Panda, whose powerful new baking technique threatens to overwhelm the competition. After surviving a series of suspicious accidents, Azuma finds inspiration in an unlikely place as he prepares for another high-stakes regional challenge.

title: The Miraculous Steamed Bread!! The Day Panda Became a Panda!
overview: Kazuma Azuma and Panda's steamed bun battle reaches its conclusion as both bakers unveil ingenious techniques to elevate a traditional chestnut filling. By preserving the authentic Japanese character of the dish while introducing his own creative twist, Azuma secures another vital victory for Pantasia in the Yakitate! 9 tournament.

title: The Sun vs the Blizzard!! The Ultimate Tart Showdown!
overview: The Yakitate! 9 semifinals pit Kazuma Azuma against Yukino in a tart-making showdown featuring Tomiura's famous fruit. After witnessing Yukino dismiss a local grower's harvest, Kazuma vows to prove the value of fresh ingredients, setting the stage for a contest where technique and quality are tested in equal measure.

title: This is the Path I Must Take!? The Road of the Loquat!
overview: Kazuma Azuma and Yukino's tart showdown reaches its climax as the judges sample two masterfully crafted desserts built around Tomiura's prized fruit. In a contest where exceptional technique meets the quality of local ingredients, the deciding taste triggers one of Judge Kuroyanagi's most extraordinary reactions yet.

title: To Whom Will You Give Your Truly Delicious Bread!? The Ja-pan, Forever!
overview: The Yakitate! 9 tournament reaches its grand finale as Kazuma Azuma faces Meister Kirisaki in the ultimate battle to determine Japan's greatest baker. Presenting the culmination of everything he has learned, Kazuma unveils his long-awaited ultimate Ja-pan, while the final judgment reveals the true purpose of baking and inspires him to continue pursuing an even greater bread.
